[Mark of Power] Whenever you ready this character, gain 1 lore for each other undamaged character you have in play.
[Bolt Stare] [Exert] — Banish chosen Illusion character.

Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
Singer 4 (This character counts as cost 4 to sing songs.)

618129.Flavor Text: Once Pascal got into Archazia’s flowerbeds, there was no getting him out.

[Back to Start Positions!] Whenever this character challenges another character, you may return a Racer character card from your discard to your hand.

618131.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)

618132.Description: Remove up to 3 damage from chosen character or location. Draw a card.
618132.Flavor Text: The moment her heart was returned, greenery burst to life and restored Te Fiti to her rightful form.

618133.Description: [For Just a Little Pain] When you play this character, you may deal 2 damage to another chosen character of yours to banish chosen character with cost 3 or less.

618135.Description:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
[Formidable Glare] When you play this character, chosen character gets -3 Strength this turn.

618136.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[We Can Figure This Out] At the start of your turn, choose one:
• Each player draws a card.
• Each player chooses and discards a card.

618137.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Mufasa.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)

618138.Description: [Unbirthday Present] Whenever a damaged character challenges another character, you may draw a card.

618139.Description: [Innovate] You pay 1 Ink less to play characters using their Shift ability.
618139.Flavor Text: “In the hands of a lesser person, this much power would be irresponsible.”

618140.Description: [Pipe Up the Crew] Whenever you play an action that isn't a song, you may ready chosen Pirate character.
618140.Flavor Text: “All right now, crew-we've got a lot to do today!”

618144.Description:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge each turn if able.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)
618144.Flavor Text: “There's no time. We have to act now!”

618145.Description: [I've Had It!] [Exert], 2 Ink, Banish 2 of your items — Deal 5 damage to chosen character.
618145.Flavor Text: "No, no, no! This is NOT THE WAY I SEE IT IN MY HEAD!"

618146.Description:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)

618147.Description: Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
618147.Flavor Text: There's nothing he can't talk his way out of.

618148.Flavor Text: “Look what I found! Can we stay here and play?”

618153.Flavor Text: “Now darlings, pay close attention to where we are. Where can you learn about the Owl from the house?”

618154.Flavor Text: “All these traps, all these locks, all these machines...If they think that’s going to stop me, they’ve sorely underestimated Edgar Balthazar!”

618155.Flavor Text: He squeezed more paint from the tube and wiggled in delight. Archazia was fun, even if she was a giant owl. She had so many new colors to paint with!

618156.Description: [I'll Show You] Whenever this character quests, you may give chosen character -2 Strength this turn.
618156.Flavor Text: "Find yourself another Illumineer. This one's taken."

618157.Description: Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
618157.Flavor Text:
“Super dog versus super log! This is AWESOME!”
—Rhino

618158.Description: [There's No Turning Back] Whenever this character quests, if he has no damage, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
618158.Flavor Text: “Looks like we’re gonna do this the hard way.”

618159.Description:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
[No Thanks Necessary] Once during your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, your other characters with Bodyguard get +1 Lore this turn.

618160.Description: [You're Beginning to Irk Me] While this character has no damage, he gains Resist +2. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)

618161.Description: [A Dog's Life] While you have a character named Tramp in play, this character gets +1 Lore.
618161.Flavor Text: “Are you sure we’re allowed in here? Jim Dear would never allow me in the kitchen.”

618162.Description:
[Hey, Pidge] If you have a character named Lady in play, you pay 1 Ink less to play this character.
[No Time for Wisecracks] When you play this character, chosen character of yours gets +1 Strength this turn for each other character you have in play.

618164.Description: [Fine Dining] [Exert], 1 Ink — If you have 2 or more characters in play, gain 1 lore.
618164.Flavor Text:
“Hey, Tony’s! Of course. The very place for a very special occasion.”
–Tramp

618165.Description:
(A character with cost 1 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Chosen character gets +1 Strength this turn for each character you have in play.
618165.Flavor Text: Wish that I could travel his way

618171.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
Vanish (When an opponent chooses this character for an action, banish them.)

618172.Description: Vanish (When an opponent chooses this character for an action, banish them.)
618172.Flavor Text: He may be spectral, but the danger is very real.

618173.Description: [This Is Not Done Yet] During an opponent's turn, whenever one of your Illusion characters is banished, you may return that character to your hand.
618173.Flavor Text: "Now that the Hexwell Crown is finally mine, no force in Lorcana can stand against me!"

618174.Description:
Vanish (When an opponent chooses this character for an action, banish them.)
[Mysterious Advantage] When you play this character, you may choose and discard a card to gain 2 lore.

618175.Description: Each player exerts all the cards in their inkwell. Then each player with more than 3 cards in their inkwell returns cards at random from their inkwell to their hand until they have 3 cards in their inkwell.

618177.Description: [That's Better] When you play this character, chosen character gains Challenger +2 this turn. (They get +2 Strength while challenging.)
618177.Flavor Text: “At last, both halves of the crown belong to me!”

618202.Description:
[Put it to Good Use] You may exert 4 items of yours to play this character for free.
[Fortune Hunter] When you play this character, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal an item card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

618205.Description:
[Coolest Collection] When you play this character, return up to 2 item cards from your discard to your hand.
[I'm Beautiful, Baby!] Whenever this character quests, you may play an item for free.

618207.Description: [You Are a Disgrace!] Whenever this character challenges another character, each opponent loses 1 lore.
618207.Flavor Text:
“Who spit in her bean curd?”
–Grandma Fa

618213.Description:
[Who's Next?] Whenever this character quests, you pay 2 Ink less for the next Puppy character you play this turn.
[Don't Be Afraid] Your Puppy characters gain Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

618246.Description: [You Can Be A Champion, Too] Your Puppy characters get +1 Willpower.
618246.Flavor Text: “Happy dogs are those who eat nutritious Kanine Krunchies!”

618249.Description: [In the Nick of Time] Whenever one of your Puppy characters is banished, you may put that card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
618249.Flavor Text: Pepper proves every puppy is part of the pack.

618250.Description: [Origin Story] When you play a Floodborn character on this card, draw a card.
618250.Flavor Text: Even with a mind as brilliant as his, the mixed ink was a unique puzzle to solve.

618257.Description:
Shift 7 (You may pay 7 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Te Ka.)
[Ancient Rage] During your turn, whenever an opposing character is exerted, banish them.

618258.Description: Return chosen damaged character to their player's hand.
618258.Flavor Text:
"Alice! Will you kindly pay attention and recite your lesson?"
—Alice's sister

618259.Description: [Rapid Fire] Whenever this character quests, you pay 1 Ink less for the next action you play this turn.
618259.Flavor Text: He loves two things: explosions and even more explosions.

618263.Description:
Shift 7
[Salvage] For each item card in your discard, you pay 1 Ink less to play this character using her Shift ability.
[Repurpose] Whenever this character quests, you may put up to 3 item cards from your discard on the bottom of your deck to gain 1 lore for each item card moved this way.

618265.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Lady.)
[Something Wonderful] When you play this character, you may return up to 2 character cards with cost 2 or less each from your discard to your hand.

618268.Flavor Text: "You presume much, to think you are welcome here."

618318.Description: [Prestidigitonium] Whenever this character quests, name a card, then reveal the top card of your deck. If it's the named card, put it into your inkwell facedown and exerted. Otherwise, put it on the top of your deck.

618320.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Queen of Hearts.)
[If I Lose My Temper...] Whenever another character is played, put a damage counter on them.

618323.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
Singer 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to sing songs.)
618323.Flavor Text: “My family’s amazing, and I’m in my family, so...”

618325.Description: [Fight Like A Bear] Your characters with 7 Strength or more can't be dealt damage.
618325.Flavor Text: "Now move. That's it. Now give me a big bear growl. Scare me."

618326.Description:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character gets +2 Strength.)
[Wisdom of His Story] During your turn, when this character is banished in a challenge, return this card to your hand and gain 1 lore.

618356.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Elsa.)
[Winter Wall] Whenever this character quests, you may exert chosen character. If you do, and you have a character named Anna in play, the chosen character can't ready at the start of their next turn.

618357.Flavor Text: Moana receives a call from the ancestors to sail to new skies and reconnect people across the entire ocean.

618685.Flavor Text: Every parent struggles with getting their baby to sleep. Kings are no different.

618688.Description: [I See You] While you have a character named Dolores Madrigal in play, this character gets +1 Lore.
618688.Flavor Text: The puzzles of the heart are trickier than anything Archazia could come up with.

618690.Description:
[Perfect Pair] You may only have 2 copies of The Glass Slipper in your deck.
[Search the Kingdom] Banish this item, [Exert] one of your Prince characters — Search your deck for a Princess character card and reveal it to all players. Put that card into your hand and shuffle your deck.

618694.Description: [Don't You Say A Word] Once during your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may return chosen character, item, or location with cost 2 or less to their player's hand, then that player draws a card.

618695.Flavor Text: “This is a place of wonder and learning. Pay attention to the Owl and see what she can teach you.”

618696.Description: [Search the Swamp] Whenever this character quests, you may deal 2 damage to another chosen character of yours to put the top 3 cards of chosen player’s deck into their discard.

618699.Description: [Startled Shriek] When you play this character, you may move up to 2 damage counters from chosen character to chosen opposing character.
618699.Flavor Text: “What the boss doesn't know won't hurt us. Much. I hope.”

618700.Description: [More to Learn] Whenever an opponent chooses this character for an action or ability, you may draw a card.
618700.Flavor Text: Archazia's library was a treasure trove of knowledge even for such an educated owl.

618702.Description: Return chosen character of yours to your hand. Exert chosen character.
618702.Flavor Text:
"Oh, I'm sure it's fine if we move these traps around. Archazia won't mind a little magic."
—Flora

618703.Description: [Pilfer and Plunder] Whenever you play an action that isn't a song, you may banish chosen item.
618703.Flavor Text: "I wasn't stealin' it! I was just keepin' it safe."

618705.Description: [Objectionable State] Damaged characters can't challenge your characters.
618705.Flavor Text: "You there! You can't be here in the state you're in. Begone before the Queen sees this mess!"

618707.Description: [Take Point] While a damaged character is in play, this character gets +2 Strength.
618707.Flavor Text: The Three of Hearts raised his spear and whispered to himself: "While others fall, a Queen's soldier stands tall."

618708.Flavor Text:
“Toby has the most splendid sense of smell of any hound I've trained. But he can be deucedly frisky.”
—Basil

618709.Description: [Fixed In No Time] When this item is banished, you pay 2 Ink less for the next item you play this turn.
618709.Flavor Text:
"I use this one a lot more than you'd think!"
—Maurice

618710.Description: [The Price of Power] [Exert] — If one of your characters was damaged this turn, gain 1 lore.
618710.Flavor Text:
"Just look at it, filled with power for its owner."
—Madame Medusa

618711.Description:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
[Breaking Story] Your other characters with Support gain +1 Strength.

618712.Description: Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
618712.Flavor Text:
"There's been a heap of legends and tall tales about Robin Hood. All different too."
—Alan-a-Dale

618713.Flavor Text: A wise leader does not shy away from difficult decisions when the safety of the pack is at stake.

618717.Description: [Winning Isn't Everything] When this character is banished, you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.

618719.Flavor Text: “And then they were like, ‘How'd you catch so many fish, Koda?’ And I said, ‘Well, you know me. I know how to catch fish.’ And they said...”

618720.Description:
(A character with cost 2 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Draw a card. Chosen character gains Bodyguard until the start of your next turn. (An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

618721.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character gets +2 Strength.)

618722.Description: Look at the top 4 cards of chosen player’s deck. Put one on the top of their deck and the rest on the bottom of their deck in any order.

618725.Description: [Energy Converter] Whenever you play a Floodborn character, if you used Shift to play them, you may draw a card.

618729.Description: [Welcome Aboard, Folks] During your turn, while you have a character named Miss Bianca or Bernard in play, this character gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)

618730.Flavor Text: “Do you see this pillar? Even after it has fallen, it still can serve a purpose.”

618733.Description:
[Close All Channels] When you play this character, characters can't exert to sing songs until the start of your next turn.
[Don't Get Any Ideas] Each player pays 2 Ink more to play actions or items. (This doesn't apply to singing songs.)

618735.Description: Your characters can't be challenged until the start of your next turn.
618735.Flavor Text:
“In times of danger, the crystal will choose a host, one of royal blood, to protect itself and its people.”
—King Kashekim Nedakh

618737.Description: [Sweet Revenge] Whenever one of your other Racer characters is banished, each opponent chooses and banishes one of their characters.

619407.Description: [Destiny Calling] Your other characters get +2 Willpower.
619407.Flavor Text: “Don't forget, you are awesome. You can handle anything. Now channel your inner awesomeness and CLEAR THIS TRAP!”

619408.Description: [There You Go] Whenever this character quests, you may remove up to 1 damage from each of your Puppy characters.
619408.Flavor Text: The best part of completing the obstacle course was finding their human at the end.

619409.Description: Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
619409.Flavor Text: "As my grandpappy, Old Reliable, used to say, save your energy for when it matters."

619410.Description: [Captive Audience] [Exert] — If you have 3 or more other characters in play, draw a card.
619410.Flavor Text: She was born to be a star no matter where she performed.

619411.Flavor Text: The devoted mice were excited to surprise Cinderella with a new dress. Smiling, Archazia gave them a spool of magic thread. “This will make it perfect,” she said.

619412.Description:
[Now It's a Party] For each character you have in play, you pay 1 Ink less to play this character.
[How's Pickings?] When you play this character, you may draw a card for each other character you have in play, then choose and discard that many cards.

619413.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Tell No Tales] Whenever one of your other characters is banished, you may remove all damage from chosen character.

619414.Description:
Singer 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to sing songs.)
[Sweet Dreams] Whenever you remove 1 or more damage from a character, ready this character. She can't quest or challenge for the rest of this turn.

619415.Description: [If the Slipper Fits] When you play this character, you may put an item card named The Glass Slipper from your discard on the bottom of your deck to gain 3 lore.
619415.Flavor Text: “But, you see, I have the other slipper.”

619416.Description: [Enduring Loyalty] When you play this character, you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character and they gain Resist +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

619417.Description: [Let's Get to Work] Whenever you return a Racer character card from your discard to your hand, you may ready chosen Racer character. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
619417.Flavor Text: "A trap is just a puzzle that's not very friendly."

619418.Description:
Puppy Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your Puppy characters.)
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

619419.Description: Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

619420.Description: [I'm Tired of Perfect] Whenever one of your characters sings a song, this character can't be challenged until the start of your next turn.
619420.Flavor Text: “I just made something unexpected. Something sharp, something new."

619421.Description: Outflank] During your turn, whenever one of your other characters is banished, this character gets +1 Lore this turn.
619421.Flavor Text: “I got that medal in the bag.”

619422.Description: [Found You, You Little Rascal] At the start of your turn, look at the cards in your inkwell. You may play a Puppy character from there for free.
619422.Flavor Text: Tricks and traps are nothing for plucky pups.

619423.Description: [He Needs Me] At the end of your turn, if this character is exerted, you may ready another chosen character of yours and remove all damage from them.

619424.Description:
[Gather Around] Whenever you play a character, this character gets +1 Lore this turn.
[Just One More] Whenever this character quests, chosen opposing character loses Strength equal to this character's Lore until the start of your next turn.

619425.Description: [Hidden Away] This character can't be challenged.
619425.Flavor Text: A true heart can thwart many an evil scheme.

619426.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Mirabel Madrigal.)
[Her Own Special Gift] Whenever this character quests, you may return a song card with cost 3 or less from your discard to your hand.

619427.Description: [Tactical Advantage] When you play this character, you may choose and discard a card to give chosen opposing character -3 Strength until the start of your next turn.
619427.Flavor Text: “Preparation and luck—you can only rely on one to win a fight!”

619428.Description: [Clear Skies, Clear Skies] Whenever one or more of your characters sings a song, gain 1 lore.
619428.Flavor Text: Archazia’s calming presence helped Pepa dispel her dark mood.

619429.Description:
(A character with cost 5 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may reveal up to 1 Madrigal character card and up to 1 song card and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the top of your deck in any order.

619430.Description: [Healing Aura] During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.
619430.Flavor Text: Martin smiled as the coil snapped into place and he felt a surge of healing energy.

619431.Description: [Untold Treasure] When you play this character, if you have an Illusion character in play, you may draw a card.
619431.Flavor Text: "At last, after all my years of searching!" —Jafar

619432.Description: [Tale of the Fifth Spirit] When you play this character, if an opponent has an exerted character in play, gain 1 lore.
619432.Flavor Text: "It's said to be a bridge between us and the magic of nature."

619433.Description: [Midnight Revel] When you play this character, each opponent chooses and exerts one of their ready characters. They can't ready at the start of their next turn.

619434.Description: [What Do We Do Now?] Whenever this character quests, if you have a character named Anna in play, gain 1 lore.

619435.Description: [Play Rough] Whenever this character quests, exert chosen opposing character.
619435.Flavor Text: “She only wants rules so she can break them!” —Archimedes

619436.Flavor Text: “You wanna get to Te Fiti, you have to go through a whole ocean of bad. Not to mention Te Ka.” —Maui

619437.Description: [I Win] When this character is banished, if you have more cards in your hand than each opponent, you may return this card to your hand.
619437.Flavor Text: “Yes, I’ve already finished this course. I'm still going to bounce a few more times.”

619438.Description: [POP!] When this character is banished in a challenge, you may draw a card.
619438.Flavor Text: "Oh, hang on. I love this bit! He pops the balloon and all those acorns go flying out. Gets me every time.” —Kronk

619439.Flavor Text: “Um, wasn’t there something the boss wanted us to take care of? Was it testing these arrows?"

619441.Description:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
[I'm Lovin' This] If an effect would cause you to discard one or more cards, you don't discard.

619442.Description: [Now You've Upset Me] Whenever one of your characters challenges, you may move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

619443.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Yzma.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Back to Work] Whenever another character is banished in a challenge, return that card to its player's hand, then that player discards a card at random.

619444.Description:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
[Winter Ambush] When you play this character, chosen opposing character can't ready at the start of their next turn.

619445.Description: [Obfuscate!] Opponents need 25 lore to win the game.
619445.Flavor Text: When it comes to magic spells, proper pronunciation is key.

619446.Description: [No Ordinary Apple] [Exert] — Choose 3 cards from chosen opponent's discard and put them on the bottom of their deck to gain 3 lore. If any Princess cards were moved this way, gain 4 lore instead.

619447.Description: [I Hear You] Whenever one of your characters sings a song, chosen opponent reveals their hand.
619447.Flavor Text: She heard Mariano’s heart skip a beat. Was it because of the puzzle, or was he looking at her?

619448.Description:
(A character with cost 2 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Gain 1 lore. Draw a card.
619448.Flavor Text: So many stars, and everybody gets to shine

619449.Flavor Text: "Weave of time, attend to me— Reveal the moments soon to be!"

619450.Description: Exert all opposing characters. Whenever one of your characters banishes another character in a challenge this turn, gain 2 lore.
619450.Flavor Text: The Hexwell surged with pure creative energy, fusing the crown’s pieces in a final burst of power.

619451.Description: [Magical Touch] During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.
619451.Flavor Text: Shanzay's coil flared, sending a tendril of mystical energy toward the damaged glimmer.

619452.Flavor Text: Once again, Drizella was confronted with a simple truth: life wasn’t fair.

619453.Flavor Text: “Processing data from Archazia's thought scrolls is taking a great deal of power. Extreme battery saver protocol engaged.”

619454.Description: [Mad Grin] When you play this character, you may deal 2 damage to chosen damaged character.
619454.Flavor Text: "He's not your average cat, after all. Then again, what cat is?" —Archazia

619455.Description: [What a Pity] When you play this character, discard your hand.
619455.Flavor Text: He'd be the first to tell you he's as magnificent as he is deadly.

619456.Description: [Draw Them Out] Whenever this character quests, opposing damaged characters gain Reckless during their next turn. (They can't quest and must challenge if able.)
619456.Flavor Text: "The final part of the crown! Jafar will be pleased."

619457.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Hiro Hamada.)
[You Can Be Way More] Your Floodborn characters that have a card under them gain Evasive and Ward. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them. Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

619458.Description: [Duck of Action] Whenever this character is challenged, you may return an action card that isn't a song card from your discard to your hand.
619458.Flavor Text: “Aye aye, Captain! I’ll get it done.”

619459.Description: [How Shall I Do It?] When you play this character, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
619459.Flavor Text: “One of these must be the right lever, but I’ll be a llama’s aunt if I can figure out which one . . ."

619460.Description: [Full Pack] While you have more cards in your hand than each opponent, this character gets +2 Lore.
619460.Flavor Text: He liked to prepare for any emergency. They happened frequently with Kuzco around.

619461.Description: [Another Recitation] Whenever this character quests, you may return chosen damaged character to their player's hand.
619461.Flavor Text: “You can’t leave yet! Don’t you want to hear the ending?” —Tweedledee

619462.Description:
Universal Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of any one of your characters.)
[Functionality Improved] When you play this character, if you used Shift to play him, remove all damage from him.

619463.Description:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
[Blathering Blatherskite] This character can challenge ready damaged characters.

619464.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[I Took Care of Everything] Whenever this character quests, another chosen character of yours gains Evasive until the start of your next turn.

619465.Description: [Fowl Play] Once during your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, chosen opponent chooses one of their characters and returns that card to their hand.
619465.Flavor Text: A captain must be inventive, commanding, and unafraid of trampolines.

619466.Description:
Drawn to a Fight If an opposing character was damaged this turn, you pay 2 Ink less to play this character.
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
[I Ain't Gone Soft!] Whenever you play an action that isn't a song, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.

619467.Description: [Oh, I Hate This!] Whenever this character is challenged, the challenging player chooses and discards a card.
619467.Flavor Text: “Out of my way! I’m going to be the first to finish!”

619468.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Pete.)
[Frightful Scheme] While this character is exerted, opposing characters can't exert to sing songs and your Pirate characters gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

619469.Description: [That's Quite Enough] [Exert] — Return chosen damaged character to their player's hand. Then, each opponent discards a card at random.

619470.Description: Each player may reveal a character card from their hand and play it for free.
619470.Flavor Text: “Congratulations, Wonderboy. You’ll make one heck of a god.” —Megara

619471.Description: [Shimmering Wings] During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, chosen character gains Evasive until the start of your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
619471.Flavor Text: The coil Martin wore lifted his spirits as well as his body.

619472.Description: [I've Got All the Luck We'll Need] Whenever this character quests, you may give chosen character of yours +2 Strength this turn.
619472.Flavor Text: “Fear will get you hurt. Luck will get you through."

619473.Description: [Royal Pain] While this character has damage, she gets +3 Strength.
619473.Flavor Text: Something told the Illumineers she'd had enough of the obstacles.

619474.Description:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
[Get 'Em!] Your other characters named Stabbington Brother gain Rush.

619475.Description: [Hive Mind] This character gets +1 Strength for each other character you have in play.
619475.Flavor Text: “Cy-Bugs are like a virus. They don’t know they’re in a game.” —Calhoun

619476.Description: [Crime of Opportunity] When you play this character, chosen opponent loses 1 lore.
619476.Flavor Text: Silence is golden. And he loves gold.

619477.Description: [Still Useful] While you have an item card in your discard, this character gets +2 Strength.
619477.Flavor Text: “Top shelf? Pshaw! If it’s a book the mademoiselle wants, I’ll find a way to get it for her!”

619478.Description: [Hurry It Up!] Whenever this character quests, chosen character of yours gains Rush and Resist +1 this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played. Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

619479.Description:
[I Won't Let You Down] This character can challenge ready characters.
[Enormous Responsibility] While this character has damage, he gets +2 Strength.

619480.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Adventurous Spirit] Whenever this character challenges another character, another chosen character of yours gets +3 Strength this turn.

619481.Description: Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
619481.Flavor Text: Nobody knows who or what he really is or what he’s planning.

619482.Description:
[Intimidating and Awe-Inspiring] Whenever one of your characters challenges, they gain Resist +2 during that challenge. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
[Guardian of Lost Souls] During your turn, whenever one of your characters banishes another character in a challenge, gain 2 lore.

619483.Description: [How on Earth Did That Happen?] When you play this character, you may banish chosen item of yours to draw a card. If the banished item is named Maurice's Machine, you may also banish chosen character with 2 Strength or less.

619484.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Star Power] Whenever this character challenges another character, your other characters get +1 Lore this turn.

619485.Description: [Explosive] Once during your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, deal 2 damage to each character in play.
619485.Flavor Text: He got what he wanted—just not the way he planned.

619486.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Mulan.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Exceptional Leader] Whenever this character challenges another character, your other characters gain "This character can challenge ready characters" this turn.

619487.Description: [A Marvelous Performance] Whenever you play an action while this character is exerted, gain 1 lore.
619487.Flavor Text: “Why stop the show when you can simply steal it?”

619488.Flavor Text: "An owl in charge? Pshaw." He glared at the others. Then his eye fell on the targets set up nearby, and he brightened. "But as long as I still get to joust . . ."

619489.Description: [I'm Your Guy] Whenever you play an action, you may give chosen character +2 Strength this turn.
619489.Flavor Text: “Okay, we rotated the globe to move the mural into position. We have the coordinates. Let's go!"

619490.Description: Ready all your characters. They gain Reckless this turn. (They can't quest and must challenge if able.)
619490.Flavor Text: "Well, as usual, diplomacy has failed us." —Lyle Tiberius Rourke

619491.Flavor Text: The last thing any gamer wants to see.

619492.Description: [Crimson Spark] During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, chosen character gets +2 Strength this turn.
619492.Flavor Text: Venturo felt a spark from his arm coil, and energy flooded his strained muscles.

619493.Description: [Break Down] When this item is banished, you may return an item card with cost 2 or less from your discard to your hand.
619493.Flavor Text: "I hope it does what I built it to do!" —Maurice

619494.Description: [Proud to Serve] Your Queen characters gain Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
619494.Flavor Text: “You must move quickly before the trap resets. Go!”

619495.Description: [I've Come to Collect] Whenever this character quests, you may banish chosen item of yours to draw a card.
619495.Flavor Text: "I can help you with your problem . . . for the right price."

619496.Flavor Text: "Fascinating. This shouldn't exist, yet it does. It may be older than the Great Illuminary itself."

619497.Description: [What a Mess] During your turn, you may banish chosen item of yours to play this character for free.
619497.Flavor Text: Helping her dad keep the flying debris to a minimum.

619498.Description: [Follow My Voice] Whenever this character quests, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Puppy character cards and put them in your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

619499.Description: [Be Sensible] Once during your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, look at the top card of your deck. You may put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.
619499.Flavor Text: "I say, what sort of contraption is this?"

619500.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Heihei.)
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
[Clear Your Mind] When you play this character, put all cards from your hand into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

619501.Description:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
[Key to the Puzzle] [Exert] — Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your inkwell facedown and exerted and the other on the top of your deck.

619502.Description: [Just So Cute!] When you play this character, chosen opposing character gets -1 Strength this turn.
619502.Flavor Text: "I want to play with the others! Can I, Dad? Please?"

619503.Description: [Pretty Great, Huh?] Whenever you play a Floodborn character, if you used Shift to play them, you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.

619504.Description: [Our Bottle Worked!] While you have a Hero character in play, this character gains Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
619504.Flavor Text: “Penny, dear, now don’t cry. We are here to help you.” —Miss Bianca

619505.Description: [Extra Assistance] Whenever this character quests, if you have no cards in your hand, draw a card for each Ally character you have in play.
619505.Flavor Text: "Oh, this is wonderful! I knew Archazia's thought scrolls would be worth a little extra effort!"

619506.Description:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
[I Got Your Four Basic Food Groups] When you play this character, chosen character gains Resist +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

619507.Description:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
[Advanced Scanner] When you play this character, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Floodborn character card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

619508.Description:
[Good Shot] During an opponent's turn, whenever one of your Ally characters is damaged, deal 1 damage to chosen opposing character.
[Fair Play] Your characters named Lady Kluck gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

619509.Description:
(A character with cost 5 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Put up to 2 cards from your discard into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
619509.Flavor Text: Where the north wind meets the sea There’s a river full of memory

619510.Description: [Brilliant Shine] During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may give chosen character -2 Strength this turn.
619510.Flavor Text: A single flash of light from the coil on Venturo's leg could blind any foe.

619512.Description:
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character gets +3 Strength.)
[Quick Reflexes] During your turn, this character gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
619512.Flavor Text: Archazia: “Why is he wearing a coconut?” Shanzay: “It’s probably better not to ask.”

619513.Description: [A Greater Purpose] During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, this character gains Resist +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

619514.Description:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)

619515.Description: [Training Exercises] Whenever one of your characters challenges another character, if it's the second challenge this turn, gain 3 lore.
619515.Flavor Text: “Every trap you disarm, every test you pass, honors us all. Well done.”

619516.Description: [My Orders Come From Jafar] When you play this character, if you have a character named Jafar in play, you may banish chosen item.
619516.Flavor Text: “Mere trinkets won’t get you any closer to Jafar.”

619517.Description: [Looking for Lunch] During your turn, this character gains Evasive while a Pirate character is in play. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
619517.Flavor Text: “I say, Captain, do you hear something?” —Peter Pan

619518.Description: [Showboating] While you have another Pirate character in play, this character gains Challenger +3. (While challenging, this character gets +3 Strength.)

619519.Description: [Where Do I Sign In?] When you play this character, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
619519.Flavor Text: "Okay this is it, time to show 'em your man walk." —Mushu

619520.Description: [Have a Little Faith] If you have an Ally character in play, you pay 2 Ink less to play this character.
619520.Flavor Text: “We’ll reach the top of this tower in no time if we work together, darling.”

619521.Description:
[Helping Hand] Whenever this character quests, you may play an Ally character with cost 3 or less for free.
[Put in the Effort] While this character is exerted, your Ally characters get +1 Strength.

619522.Description:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
[You've Got to be Brave] During an opponent's turn, when this character is banished, deal 2 damage to each opposing character.

619523.Description: [Stirring Spirit] During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, you may play a character for free.
619523.Flavor Text: He leads the way with a steadfast heart.

619524.Description: Deal 1 damage each to up to 2 chosen characters.
619524.Flavor Text: "We've had enough of your shenanigans! Take that!" —Merryweather

619525.Description: [Metallic Flow] During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
619525.Flavor Text: As the coil clicked onto Shanzay's arm, she felt a strengthened sense of clarity.

619526.Description: [Precision Strike] [Exert], 1 Ink — Chosen character gains Challenger +2 this turn. (They get +2 Strength while challenging.)
619526.Flavor Text: “Do not sit idle while others quest for glory.” —Li Shang

619733.Description:
Singer 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to sing songs.)
[Sweet Dreams] Whenever you remove 1 or more damage from a character, ready this character. She can't quest or challenge for the rest of this turn.

619734.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Mirabel Madrigal.)
[Her Own Special Gift] Whenever this character quests, you may return a song card with cost 3 or less from your discard to your hand.

619735.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Bolt.)
[Mark of Power] Whenever you ready this character, gain 1 lore for each other undamaged character you have in play.
[Bolt Stare] [Exert] — Banish chosen Illusion character.

619736.Description:
[Perfect Pair] You may only have 2 copies of The Glass Slipper in your deck.
[Search the Kingdom] Banish this item, [Exert] one of your Prince characters — Search your deck for a Princess character card and reveal it to all players. Put that card into your hand and shuffle your deck.

619737.Description: [Obfuscate!] Opponents need 25 lore to win the game.

619738.Description: [This Is Not Done Yet] During an opponent's turn, whenever one of your Illusion characters is banished, you may return that card to your hand.

619740.Description:
[Hey, Pidge] If you have a character named Lady in play, you pay 1 Ink less to play this character.
[No Time for Wisecracks] When you play this character, chosen character of yours gets +1 Strength this turn for each other character you have in play.

619741.Description: [Unbirthday Present] Whenever a damaged character challenges another character, you may draw a card.

619742.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Hiro Hamada.)
[You Can Be Way More] Your Floodborn characters that have a card under them gain Evasive and Ward. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them. Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

619743.Description: Each player may reveal a character card from their hand and play it for free.

619744.Description: [A Marvelous Performance] Whenever you play an action while this character is exerted, gain 1 lore.

619745.Description:
Shift 7
[Salvage] For each item card in your discard, you pay 1 Ink less to play this character using her Shift ability.
[Repurpose] Whenever this character quests, you may put up to 3 item cards from your discard on the bottom of your deck to gain 1 lore for each item card moved this way.

619746.Description: [The Price of Power] [Exert] — If one of your characters was damaged this turn, gain 1 lore.

619747.Description:
[Coolest Collection] When you play this character, return up to 2 item cards from your discard to your hand.
[I'm Beautiful, Baby!] Whenever this character quests, you may play an item for free.

619748.Description:
(A character with cost 5 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Put up to 2 cards from your discard into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

619749.Description: [Stirring Spirit] During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, you may play a character for free.

619750.Description: Your characters can't be challenged until the start of your next turn.

710941.Description:
I've Waited Here Ages Now,
and I'd be alone if not for
the company of my ink friends.

The others have finally
arrived from across the sea.
seeking knowledge.
Seeking my help.
They're worried. But they're
not worried nearly enough...

710995.Description: Complete 20 card set of puzzle insert cards from Archazia's Island.
